# Therapy Group of DC

> > Therapy Group of DC is a licensed mental health practice in Washington DC's Dupont Circle offering evidence-based therapy for anxiety, depression, trauma, couples issues, and life transitions since 2003.

Therapy Group of DC specializes in personalized therapist matching using multiple evidence-based approaches including CBT, psychodynamic therapy, EMDR, ACT, and EFT. The practice serves the Washington DC area with both in-person and telehealth options, focusing on anxiety, depression, trauma, relationships, career transitions, and LGBTQ+ affirming care.

- [Sex Therapy in Washington DC | Therapy Group of DC](https://therapygroupdc.com/sex-therapy-in-washington-dc): Confidential sex therapy for sexual health and dysfunction with trauma-informed care.
